hero.title: Trade what happens next.
hero.subtitle: Binary markets on real-world outcomes. Every price is the crowd's live estimate of how likely something is — buy the side you think is right, and see how your read compares.
hero.disclaimer: Play points only — no deposits, no cash value.
live.title: Live markets
how.title: How it works
how.pick.title: Pick a question
how.pick.body: Every market is a real-world question with a live price — elections, sport, tech, culture.
how.prices.title: Prices are probabilities
how.prices.body: A Yes price of 62¢ means the market prices Yes at 62%. Prices move as people trade.
how.settle.title: Correct predictions settle at 100 points
how.settle.body: When a market resolves, each correct contract settles at 100 points. Incorrect ones settle at zero.
